title: Export reliability
goal: Make exports dependable across the app and its worker service.
finishLine: Required PRs merged and the end-to-end export workflow verified.

needs.ask: Should expired export links remain visible?
context: The UI PR needs a settled retention rule.
Existing tests cover downloads, but do not specify expired-link behavior.

options.label: Keep the entry
options.effect: Users can see export history and regenerate an expired download.

options.label: Hide expired entries
options.effect: The list stays shorter, but users lose that history.

needs.ask: How many retries should an interrupted export get?
context: Other worker jobs use three attempts.

options.label: Five attempts
options.effect: Rides out longer outages but reports failures later.

needs.ask: When should the simulator fixture reset?

options.label: Once per run
options.effect: Runs faster, but state can leak between test classes.

options.label: Between test classes
options.effect: Adds about a minute and stops state leaking.

needs.ask: Which component should render export history?
context: The history view needs a sortable list.
needs.basis: Project rule: history views reuse the shared data table. Swapping it later needs no data change.

needs.ask: Should a retried export keep its original job ID?
context: Keeping the ID lets users follow one export through retries.

work.title: Retry interrupted export jobs
work.description: Retry interrupted exports without creating duplicate jobs or losing cancellation requests.

work.title: Show export history and regeneration
work.description: Add an export history view with download and regeneration controls.

work.title: Repair the shared simulator fixture
work.description: Restore the shared simulator fixture so export UI checks can run reliably.

work.title: Improve export progress estimates
work.description: Explore more accurate completion estimates for long-running exports.
work.origin: Discovered during W1 review; separate from retry correctness.

work.title: Add idempotency keys to export jobs
work.description: Give each export a stable key so a retry cannot start a second job.
work.origin: Split from W1 so retries could land on a stable job identity.

revisits.title: Retry delay remains fixed
revisits.tradeoff: A fixed delay keeps the first repair small but may delay recovery during bursts.
revisits.revisit: After the retry PR lands, inspect production retry timings.

revisits.title: Job IDs outlive their first attempt
revisits.tradeoff: Reusing the original job ID keeps one export easy to follow but merges each attempt's logs.
revisits.revisit: If support needs per-attempt logs, add an attempt number.
